title: A Landfall for the Escarpment
author: Wren Winterbourne
blurb: Yara Crane, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
